decision.observation: Hornet stands on the mossy ground right of the East Grotto wheel beside the black mushroom; small white sparkle/glow bits lie on the ground left of her feet. The green-eyed critter previously on the mushroom cap is gone. Masks remain low (~3 of 6 with dark pips) and the silk bar looks mostly empty.
decision.hypothesis: With health low and silk depleted, Bind won't heal; the reliable heal is the Moss Grotto hub wheel-bench. The known exit from this pocket is climbing the upper-right cliff back to the pillar alcove and through the lit pocket chamber toward the hub.
decision.memory: East Grotto pocket: wheel #3 inert to Up; only hub wheel-bench confirmed healing. Route back: up-right cliff climb → pillar/pink-shell alcove → lit pocket chamber → dark corridor → hub bench.
